rationale: The Latin anchor *appendere* (to weigh out, pay by weight) and the specific Biblical attestations — Abraham weighing 400 shekels of silver (Gen. 23:16) and sins/calamity being weighed on a balance (Job 6:2) — all indicate the active, transitive act of determining/measuring weight, which corresponds precisely to weigh.v.03 ("determine the weight of"), not a stative or figurative sense.
